notes.title: PATCH 20. OCTOBER
notes.content:
Patch 20 October for The Altered Lands is now live!

Hello adventurers!

I fixed things below:


 Removed eye bulge when idle with bow
 Added rune stones to switch player class in Anathreal, Birch Wood Farm
 Added invisible frames during dodge
 Fixed craftables in The Lost Isles
 Added lot of more material spawns (mining stones, bushes, shrooms, etc...)
 Polished Recall stone (Teleport scrolls to spawn portal back to innkeeper)
 All characters textures optimized
 Added arrow to show direction to Quest goal location
 Added few items(poisons, drinks and spears)
 World optimization

Let me know if you find any problems in game or want something to change! 
Any feedback is welcome and I want to continue to develop the game with your support!

notes.title: HOTFIX JUNE 30
notes.content:
BUG FIXES
[olist]

 Attack lock timer trimmed (After attack there was little delay before you can move or dodge.)
 Spell cooldown fixed (When you used all the mana you could no longer cast spells at all.)
 Texture optimization (not wanted 4k textures to 2k)
 Combat timer for food removed (You couldn’t eat during or for 30 seconds during the fight.)
[/olist]

I have almost finished creating new world: The Lost Isles and that semi large open world map is in this update but not available yet for gamers. Coming soon!

level graphic optimization (better LOD's, textures, post processing)
